name: Phone Connect
author: Brett
description: Connects Brett's Android phone to the console through the small Phone Connect companion app (phone-connect@1). Pair the phone with a code or QR, see it online, revoke it. The phone shows a floating toolbar and popups for approvals, alerts and notifications that act in place, watches axHub with the screen off (Monitor, with auto-approval rules kept here), opens amberxai.com pages on command, and records what the phone plays (Audio Output Recorder: 30-minute parts to axHub, transcribed on the VPS, mic only when switched on). Replaces AmberX.
